steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: While I was out cold, I tried and failed to wake up, over and over again. That was a chaotic world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There, in the depths of Mania were many unimaginable pains and inescapable traps.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I had good intentions. I tried my best. It shouldn't have ended up like this. The result shouldn't have been this ludicrous.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was it because I didn't try hard enough? Was it because I'm too naive, too reckless, not wise enough, not strong enough? Was it because I'm weak?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or was it because Syndicate didn't deserve me risking my life to change? Were the people simply too corrupted, and were my efforts pointless? Was that the reason why I ended up like this?
${PlayerName}'s gaze turns icy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I found myself trapped in darkness, the most terrifying kind. I couldn't break free on my own. It was then that I realized I knew nothing about human beings.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm weak too.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief?
Panic seizes Hecate for the first time. She takes ${PlayerName}'s hand.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, you're not weak. You always give it your all in battle, always go out of your way to protect us. I've seen this with my own eyes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: When I feel helpless, it's the thought of you that always gives me strength.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You are not weak, not one bit!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, but I think it's okay to feel weak.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because I'm not strong enough, I've received help from many people. Those who have passed away, those who are still struggling, those I remember, those I've forgotten...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hecate, you've met someone like that too, haven't you?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: She's never asked anything of you. All her efforts to protect you were to repay what that Chief did for her. People have brought you back from the riot. And people out there are still trying to look for your Chief.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Be extra careful when you are on your own. Make it out alive and return safely to the ones who matter the most to you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Something very profound, indeed. Remember, we're Sinners. We have hearts of our own, and that's what gives us strength. No one can control our hearts.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your voice, Hecate, it stood out from the rest. You came to me by following the shackles. Someone pushed me out, and you were on the other end, pulling me toward you with the shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You see, we are the same. This is our heart.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't want to call it "shackles" now. It's an emotional bond of the utmost importance for me, my anchor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So I'm happy that you shared your feelings with me. I want to be closer to your heart. And I'm also happy to know that you need me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm sorry that I can't give you what you need right now. The shackles have been tainted, and I've lost my power. I must reclaim it first. Trust me; I can do it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But before I can do that, I need your help. Would you help me?
[Exit Memory]
Hecate opens her eyes, back to reality, back to the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Yooga! Yooga! Here comes the medicine!

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: The contamination here is still dangerously high. Quick! Get everyone out of here.
From above the battlefield comes the roar of a helicopter. They look up, greeted by a familiar face.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You are...?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It has been confirmed that those are the missing MBCC Sinners S-019 and S-098. Arrest Squad, come with me; let's proceed to the scene to provide protection.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Command Center, please contact Paradeisos. Wait, don't contact Paradeisos. Contact the FAC, the 9th Agency, all departments of the Executive Committee. Sync the live visuals. If the visuals are disrupted, sync the audio, detect M-values, and do whatever else that might help.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: New developments! The Black Ring is collapsing. The Purge Order won't be of any help and should be terminated immediately. There are still people fighting out here. ${PlayerName} is still fighting!

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Corso, I'm going ask for your help once more. Please...

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: No problem, I'm more than happy to help.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I can't remember the last time I found Syndicate so endearing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Protect Hella and yourself. This isn't an order, nor is it an assignment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need you, just like you need me.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I... won't be afraid anymore.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I may be weak, but I've got people who help me, and they've got me. This is the source of my strength. This is what brings me closer to you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Thank you for telling me you need me, Chief. I'll protect Hella; she's very important to us. Now, please go fight with all your strength, and reclaim your shackles.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I believe in you, just like you believe in me.
